text:
Alex: Quick proposal — for the weekly triage starting next week I want to try splitting the 30m into a Hotfix lane + Backlog + Quick RFCs. Rough split: 10m hotfixes (owner pings), 10m backlog grooming, 10m RFC quick-calls. Rotate hotfix owner weekly. Thoughts? cc @Mira @Sanjay

Mira: +1 on giving hotfixes a dedicated lane. Can we reserve 2-3 mins at the top for immediate blockers? Those tend to eat time if we don't call them out early. :eyes:

Sanjay: I like the split. One note — RFC votes rarely resolve live, suggest we treat RFC quick-calls as "blockers/clarifications only" and do async thumbs-up for approval beforehand. I can take the hotfix owner rota for week of Apr 6.

Emma: Heads up I have a recurring conflict Mon 09:00. If we keep Mondays some folks will miss. Can we consider Tue 10:00 or Wed 09:00 instead? :calendar:

Alex: Good catch. Let's do a fast poll: react :one: for Tue 10am, :two: for Wed 9am. If majority picks one I'll update the recurring invite. Also agree on a 2-3 minute blockers slot at start.

DevOps-Bot: Quick summary: proposed template posted, awaiting reactions. (automated) :robot_face:

Mira: :one:

Sanjay: :one:

Emma: :two: — I can make Tue occasionally but prefer Wed regular.

Alex: Looks like Tue 10am gets the votes. I'll switch the invite to Tue 10am weekly and add the agenda snippet below to the calendar description. If this causes problems DM me and we'll revert.

Alex: Agenda snippet to paste in invite:
```
Weekly engineering triage (30m)
- 0:00–0:03 — Quick blockers (one-liners)
- 0:03–0:13 — Hotfix lane (owner pings, handoffs)
- 0:13–0:23 — Backlog grooming (pick top 3 bugs/prs)
- 0:23–0:30 — RFC quick-checks / action items (async votes preferred)
Hotfix owner rota: rotate weekly; current volunteers: Sanjay (week of Apr 6)
Link to shared triage board: https://redwood.infra/triage-board
```

Mira: Nice. Can we also add a short note: "If you need more than 2 minutes for a blocker, file a quick issue and flag for follow-up" so the meeting stays timeboxed?

Alex: Done, I'll add that sentence to the invite description.

Sanjay: FYI I'll add myself to the rota doc and ping Emma for runtime/infra handoffs when needed.

Emma: Thanks — I can cover alternate weeks for runtime. If anyone else wants to be on the rota ping Alex.

Alex: Thanks all. I'll update the recurring event (Tue 10am), drop the agenda in the description, and post a short note in #eng after the update. :thumbsup:
